Its small headcount suggests a high reliance on a flexible sub-contractor labor pool.

sector_risks.description: Fixed-price contracts signed 6-12 months ago may become loss-making due to volatile material and labor costs.
Commercial construction is prone to 'pay when paid' dynamics and retention holding, impacting SME cash flow.
Difficulty in recruiting skilled tradespeople in the UK market is driving up the cost of labor.

key_findings: The company sits in the £2M-£5M revenue bracket, suggesting a baseline EBITDA multiple of 2.0x - 3.5x.
The small headcount of 9 indicates a lean core team but high vulnerability to key-man risk and labor market fluctuations.
Sector attractiveness is moderate (52/100) due to cyclical economic pressures and high competition in the SME construction space.
Valuation will be heavily influenced by the 'quality' of the order book and the percentage of work that is repeat business vs. one-off tenders.
narrative: Manor Building Solutions (UK) Ltd is a micro-to-small player in the UK commercial construction market. While its revenue of £2.4M is respectable for its headcount, the business likely operates with the typical challenges of an SME contractor: high project-specific risk and significant owner involvement. In the current UK climate, buyers will look closely at the pipeline of contracted work and the company's ability to pass on inflationary costs to clients. A valuation at the lower-to-mid end of the 2.0x-3.5x EBITDA range is expected unless the company can demonstrate a unique niche or a highly diversified, non-owner-dependent sales process.
